brief:
Oxfam International is urging world leaders gathering for the UN General Assembly and Climate Week in New York to confront what the organization describes as an "inequality emergency," Democracy Now! reported. Executive director Amitabh Behar emphasized that the global landscape has fundamentally shifted since the UN's founding in 1945, requiring urgent action on climate change, artificial intelligence, and the Gaza conflict.

The appeal comes as leaders convene to address interconnected crises that Oxfam links to deepening global inequalities and their consequences for vulnerable populations worldwide.

title: Oxfam calls on UN to address inequality, climate and Gaza crisis
